# Mutation check (generated by `dotnet run --project code/tools/Auditor.Tools -- mutation-check --write`)

Each row breaks ONE rule in a scratch copy of the code (the repository is not touched) and runs the invariant tests, the per-category golden tests, the synthetic cases, the sample regression guard and the validator tests (InvariantsTests, GoldenCategoriesTests, ExtraCasesTests, SampleRegressionGuard, ValidateTests). Control: the unmodified copy passes all 55 of those tests, so every failure below is caused by the mutation. M1-M3 are the three requested mutations; M4-M5 are extra.

| mutation | broken rule | edited file | tests run | failing tests | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1 canonical order | inside REMEDIATION, flows must be disabled and restores blocked BEFORE records are deleted (spec 6.5; canonical operation order of problem_statement.md): DELETE_RECORD is moved ahead of DISABLE_DATA_FLOW in the shared operation table, so the pipeline and its own validator still agree with each other | `code/src/Auditor/Schema.cs` | 55 | 8 | **KILLED** |
| M2 COMPLETE rows cite evidence | every step of a COMPLETE row must carry an evidence id: verification steps of compliant records stop citing their file | `code/src/Auditor/Audit.cs` | 55 | 7 | **KILLED** |
| M3 NOT_APPLICABLE equals [] | a request that does not authorize deletion must produce steps_json == []: the non-deletion early return now emits a step | `code/src/Auditor/Audit.cs` | 55 | 4 | **KILLED** |
| M4 policy table: REDACT (extra) | REDACT categories (support message, delivery log, tombstone) must be fixed by REDACT_RECORD: the table now says ANONYMIZE_RECORD | `code/src/Auditor/Policy.cs` | 55 | 5 | **KILLED** |
| M5 legal hold expiry (extra) | a legal hold that ended before audit_at is no longer a retain requirement: the expiry check is removed | `code/src/Auditor/Audit.cs` | 55 | 1 | **KILLED** |
